payroll.purpose: base of incidence of a rule version
progressive brackets of a BRACKET rule
run per unit x service month

permissions.authority: TerritorialAuthority(data_type HR) through the Finance runtime; permission before target (F-06); rules at national level (GENERAL_DIRECTION root)

employment.identity: Person (people) by public_id, visible through PeopleAuthority; no personal attribute copied; person_employment never read or written
employment.people_context: EMPLOYMENT opened on create, closed on end

compensation.history: append-only: change = close the current line the day before + open a new one under the employment lock; retroactive / overlapping changes refused
compensation.rule_based_components: no amount on the line (applicability only); value only from an APPROVED rule

rules.approval: PAYROLL_RULES_APPROVE at national level, approver != drafter, PAYROLL_RULE_SOURCE document with Files authority of the approver
rules.overlap: no two APPROVED versions of a component intersect (component row lock)

production_gate.order: permission (403) -> run scope (404 concealed) -> production gate (409)
production_gate.tests_enable_it: config() of the test process / worker process / E2E API process only; never a file, seed or default

input_hash.canonicalization: JSON, object keys sorted (byte order) recursively, lists pre-sorted, strings/ints/bools/null only (float refused), JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES
covers: compensations (salary base, components, subsidies, deductions, benefits)

privacy.audit: hr.compensation_viewed on every salary read; no monetary value in audit metadata

run_routes.detail_and_list: PAYROLL_MANAGE | PAYROLL_APPROVE | PAYROLL_POST | HR_COMPENSATION_VIEW on the run unit (totals only, audited payroll.viewed)
run_routes.employee_breakdown: HR_COMPENSATION_VIEW on the run unit only, else the concealed 404 (audited payroll.employee_detail_viewed, no value in metadata)
run_routes.summary_and_csv: run viewers or FINANCE_PAYROLL_SUMMARY_VIEW (totals per component, headcount; never a person)

calculate.note: recalculation replaces the lines of a CALCULATED run; the previous input_hash stays in the audit trail

approve.stale: input_hash recomputed under shared locks; different or unresolvable -> PAYROLL_INPUT_STALE (409; ADR C5 STALE_CALCULATION)

post.period: entry_date default = min(service month end, today); another month needs a reason (D29); Finance period OPEN or PERIOD_CLOSED

pay.accounts: one OPEN CASH/BANK account of the employing unit (V1)

run_pipeline.population: employments of the unit intersecting the service month (temporal history; never the current Person state); one Person once (PAYROLL_POPULATION_CONFLICT)
run_pipeline.proration: no approved policy: an employment or a compensation line that does not cover the whole service month -> PAYROLL_PRORATION_POLICY_MISSING (422); never 30 days / calendar days / working days, never a full salary silently

calculation.pure_function_of: the canonical input payload (preimage of input_hash)
calculation.rule_based: only the APPROVED rule of the period: base = sum of the employee amounts of the rule base components; FLAT half_up(base x rate); BRACKET half_up(fixed + (base - excess_over) x rate)
calculation.rounding: HALF_UP to 2 decimals per component line; totals are exact sums of rounded lines
calculation.invariant: sum of lines by class = run totals; headcount = distinct employments (checked on calculate / approve / post)

accrual.debits: OPERATING_EXPENSE (the rubric ledger account) per rubric PER_* for EARNING and EMPLOYER_CHARGE components
accrual.balance: sum debit = gross + employer charges = sum credit
accrual.aggregation: by rubric / ledger account / liability role; never by employee

payment.lines: Dr PAYROLL_NET_PAYABLE / Cr CASH|BANK (financial account) = posted net
payment.statutory_liabilities: unchanged: PAYROLL_WITHHOLDINGS and PAYROLL_EMPLOYER_CHARGES stay owed until a LIABILITY_PAYMENT

reversal.lines: exact inverse of the accrual, reversal_of = accrual entry

finance_posting.idempotency: payroll_postings UNIQUE (run_id, stage) + UNIQUE entry_id + idempotency_requests (PA-/PP-/PR-<run>) + run FOR UPDATE + locking posting read: a retry or a concurrent second call returns the existing entry (replayed=true)
finance_posting.finance_sees: aggregated lines only; no person, employment, name or individual amount in journal_entries / journal_lines

reports.DRE: the accrual in the posting month (personnel expense by rubric)
reports.DOAF: the payment as an external application in the payment month; the accrual has no CASH/BANK line

concurrency.C5: compensation change vs approval: change first -> PAYROLL_INPUT_STALE; approval first -> APPROVED with the old inputs, the change only for future calculations
concurrency.C6: two POST -> 1 ACCRUAL posting, 1 journal (second = replay)
concurrency.C11: two PAY -> 1 PAYMENT posting, 1 journal, cash debited once
concurrency.POST_x_close: post first -> counted in the close; close first -> PERIOD_CLOSED
concurrency.PAY_x_close: pay first -> counted; close first -> PERIOD_CLOSED, cash unchanged
concurrency.mechanism: real processes, before-commit hold (payroll.before_commit / finance.before_commit), waiter observed in performance_schema.data_lock_waits

errors.404: RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND (unknown / malformed / out-of-scope run, account or breakdown without HR_COMPENSATION_VIEW; byte-identical)
errors.403: FORBIDDEN (permission held nowhere, decided before any target)

needs_policy: proration of partial months (entry / exit / mid-month change)
13.o salary, holiday subsidy and adjustment runs (which components, bases, timing)
IRT base net of INSS (rule bases are sums of components; no subtraction in V1)
payment from several accounts (V1: one account per payment)
period-close warning for CALCULATED / APPROVED runs (D29)
